summary.text: Monica Church represents Idaho House District 19, Seat A, and the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory lists Church as Minority Caucus Chair.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Church was born in Boise and holds an M.S.Ed. in education leadership and administration and bachelor's degrees in secondary education and history from Boise State University, plus a B.A. in philosophy from Whitman College.
It describes Church as a licensed educator and administrator and a City of Boise ethics commissioner.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
